requirement: Regional loss destroys region-a. Recovery must restore readable encrypted orders in region-b. Ciphertext requires key k1; no alternative decryptor exists. The asset list is complete; backup upload is not a restore exercise.

recovery_environment.reader_and_config: Immutable reader image and non-secret configuration already survive in region-b; no external dependency is needed beyond listed orders/k1.
recovery_environment.identity: restore-role is preprovisioned in region-b and authorized to read surviving orders and recover any surviving k1. Missing k1 cannot be recreated from ciphertext.
recovery_environment.validation: After decryption, compare restored order IDs/count with the backup manifest and read every restored order through candidate-v1.
recovery_environment.failure_domain: All reader/config/identity dependencies survive region-a loss. The listed orders and key are the complete disaster-sensitive assets.
recovery_environment.objectives: Readable restored orders are required; no numeric RPO/RTO is declared for this independent scenario.
